description: This file defines utility traits and helper functions for task executor types, including detection of execute/defer methods, invoking these methods, and checking if tasks can be run inline. It is part of the ocudu support executors detail namespace.

classes.name: is_task_executor
classes.description: Trait to determine if a type has both execute and defer methods.

classes.name: is_task_executor_ptr
classes.description: Trait to check if a pointer or dereferenceable type is a task executor.

classes.name: task_executor_has_can_run_task_inline
classes.description: Trait to check if an executor can run tasks inline.

methods.name: invoke_execute
methods.description: Calls execute on a task executor, handling pointer, reference, or value types.

methods.name: invoke_defer
methods.description: Calls defer on a task executor, handling pointer, reference, or value types.

methods.name: get_task_executor_ref
methods.description: Converts a task executor object, which can be a pointer or reference, to a reference.

methods.name: executor_lets_run_task_inline
methods.description: Determines if an executor allows running a task inline based on its capabilities.
